## Coming from BacaKomik?
On Android, Yoru is a new app next to BacaKomik. Before you uninstall BacaKomik, bring your library over: sync it with Drive in BacaKomik and sign in to Drive sync in Yoru, or back it up in BacaKomik and restore the file in Yoru (More → Backup & sync). The 2.17.0 notes have the details.

## Changes

### Changed
- Windows: the app is now `yoru.exe` in `Programs\Yoru`. Updating from BacaKomik moves it there and removes the old `Programs\BacaKomik` folder. On the first start, your library moves from `%APPDATA%\kurodev\BacaKomik` to `%APPDATA%\kurodev\Yoru`.
- Linux: the program inside the AppImage is called `yoru`.
- macOS: from the next update on, the app is replaced as `Yoru.app`.
- The default extension repo is now `https://yoru-ext.kurodev.org/index.json`. A repo saved under the old address uses the new one, and the old address keeps working for older versions.
